mechanism_narrative: A quarterly increase in GDPC1, indicating strengthening economic demand, boosts consumer and business confidence, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 50% of quarters with positive GDPC1 growth, or walk-forward Rank IC < 0.05 over any 5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When FEDFUNDS exceeds 4.5%, signaling a tightening monetary cycle, investors anticipate reduced borrowing capacity, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances with FEDFUNDS above 4.5%, or walk-forward Rank IC < 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Jointly, when UNRATE falls below 4% and PAYEMS shows a 3-month average increase of > 200k jobs, signaling a strong labor market, S&P 500 forward returns are positive over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 55% of triggered instances, or walk-forward Rank IC < 0.04 over any 4-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in INDPRO, indicating improved industrial production, enhances productivity and thus S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, but only during non-recessionary periods.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.01 over any 2-year rolling window during non-recession periods, or 20-day forward returns in such periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.1).

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in HOUST, signaling strengthened housing demand, positively influences S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days, but with diminishing returns after 3 consecutive monthly increases.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 50% of triggered instances after 1-3 months of HOUST growth, or walk-forward Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When CPIAUCSL exceeds its 6-month moving average, indicating rising inflation expectations, and FEDFUNDS is below 3%, investors anticipate future monetary tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 55% of triggered instances, or walk-forward Rank IC < 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Always, a low UNRATE (< 5%) is associated with positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, as it reflects a strong labor market and overall economic health.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.04 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during low UNRATE periods (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Jointly, when RSAFS increases by > 5% month-over-month and GDPC1 shows a quarterly increase, signaling robust demand and economic growth, S&P 500 forward returns are positive over the next 20 trading days, but only during early-cycle expansions.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS > 5% MoM increase and GDPC1 quarterly increase
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 50% of triggered instances, or walk-forward Rank IC < 0.01 over any 4-year rolling window during early-cycle expansions.
